rules.providerOnboarding: No provider with a publicly stated KYB/KYC requirement
rules.branchCreation: Create only the active release branch. Create the next branch from main only after the current RC tag is merged.
rules.staging: One Railway staging service follows only the active release branch.

releases.shipGate: Fresh Uniswap quote and successful simulation; all user-paid costs are disclosed; official-app handoff requotes; no signing method exists.
Allowances match direct onchain reads against versioned canonical spender addresses; the feature remains read-only.
Receipts, logs, and movements reconcile; confidence is visible; ambiguous or unsupported intent is not guessed.
Canonical balances and approvals reconcile at a finalized block; saved addresses and watchlists remain browser-local.
Primary-source allowlists and oracle staleness checks pass; no restricted data redistribution or transaction CTA exists.
Historic calldata and transaction parameters cannot enter the new path; a user-selected amount and fresh Uniswap quote are required.
